clauses.scope_note: Section I.3.b: applies when a Service Suspension occurs, including the suspension grounds in I.3.a. The material concerns Anthropic's provision of the Services, not a Customer use permission.
clauses.condition_explanation: service_suspension_occurs means a Service Suspension as defined in I.3.a. The notice duty is to use reasonable efforts; resumption is required as soon as reasonably possible only after the event giving rise to suspension is cured, where curable.

obligation_items.content: Use reasonable efforts to provide Customer written notice of the Service Suspension.
obligation_items.object: Written notice of the Service Suspension to Customer

obligation_items.content: Resume providing access to the Services as soon as reasonably possible.
obligation_items.trigger: The event giving rise to the Service Suspension is cured, where curable.

coverage_notes: Sections I.2 and J contain operative termination and dispute procedures that do not map faithfully to the allowed activities. The suspension notice and resumption duties in I.3.b are represented; the remaining procedural rules are identified as unresolved in the paragraph audit.

paragraph_audit.reason: The added clause captures Anthropic's suspension-notice and resumption duties, and the cited anchors capture the termination rights and resulting access restriction. The termination notice and breach-cure procedures, suspension grounds and reasonable-belief standard, and survival provisions are not fully represented by those clauses.

The paragraph imposes good-faith informal-resolution, dispute-notice, and timely-response duties and specifies arbitration and equitable-relief procedures. These procedural duties and mechanisms do not fit an allowed activity.
